text_blocks.snippet: Several medications can lower PSA (prostate-specific antigen) levels, including 5-alpha reductase inhibitors like finasteride and dutasteride, statins, thiazide diuretics, and NSAIDs like ibuprofen and naproxen. These medications can be prescribed for conditions like enlarged prostate or high cholesterol, but they can also affect PSA levels, which are monitored during prostate cancer screening.
